summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of incorrect separability matrix computation for nested CompoundModels, but it may introduce behavioral regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The patch modifies the behavior of the `_cstack` function, which could potentially break existing untested behavior in other parts of the codebase.
The patch does not include additional tests to verify the correctness of the separability matrix computation for various nested CompoundModels, leaving room for future regressions.
